simple.meaning: כָּרוֹז (kârôwz) is a Hebrew word meaning “a herald.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּרוֹז (H3744) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כָּרוֹז (H3744) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כָּרוֹז (kârôwz) / H3744 is traced through Daniel 3:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3744. karoz [ כָּרוֺז ] noun masculine herald (loan-word from Greek κήρυξ , κηρύσσειν (K § 64, 4 Krauss ii. 296 f. ; Nö GGA 1884, 1019 doubts ); ᵑ7 id. , Syriac (see Brook), Christian-Palestinian Aramaic [] Schulth Lex. 97 ; compare D § 97 near the end , also K § 64, 4 Bev Dan 5:29 M § 88 ); — emphatic כָּדוֺוָא 3:4 .
